d: An anthropomorphic wolf with a mature, focused expression, featuring a coat of platinum white fur and a long, braided beard of the same shade. The eyes are a sharp, golden-yellow, and the build is muscular and imposing. The outfit consists of dark brown scaled armor on the shoulders and legs, a long charcoal-grey cape, and a brown leather glove on the right hand, paired with gold bands around the wrists. The character holds a large, double-edged spear with an ornate dark hilt and a cream-colored blade. BODY COLOR: platinum white LEGS: digitigrade with large paws and black claws
